name: Overgrown Ruins
description: Forests that swallowed the dead cities of Earth: emerald meadows, rust-orange stone and relay dishes tilted under the canopy.
role: The most common physical wilderness. It hides relics and salvage under living green.
ambience: Quiet, humid and green, broken by the creak of old metal and distant wildlife.
paletteDirection: Emerald and spring greens, rust-orange stone, faded steel blue for pre-Cataclysm machinery.
